item.title: Issue #2914 created
item.description:
Define a new char/codepoint type.

Some functions operate on values that are restricted to the XML Char production to specify a character/Unicode codepoint. Some possible names:

  • xs:char -- could be confused with the C char type, but is consistent with the XML Char production;
  • xs:codepoint -- clearer that this is a Unicode codepoint but could be confusing to people not familiar with Unicode terminology.

This type has two representations:

  • an xs:string of length 1 (assuming that length is in terms of codepoints);
  • an xs:integer (or xs:long or xs:unsignedLong if using a minimal sized underlying type) with allowed values limited to those defined by the XML Char` production.

As such, such a type should/would be coercible to either type resulting in either a 1 character string or an integer respectively.
